title: Self-Checking Scoreboard with Reference Model
description: Implement a UVM scoreboard that consumes monitor transactions, predicts expected ALU results, and reports mismatches automatically.

steps.title: Step 1: Implement the Scoreboard
steps.instructions: Open `testbench.sv` and implement `alu_scoreboard` with a `uvm_tlm_analysis_fifo`, reference model, and compare logic.

steps.title: Step 2: Wire Analysis Traffic
steps.instructions: Create the scoreboard in `alu_env` and connect `monitor.ap` to the scoreboard FIFO's `analysis_export` in `connect_phase`.

steps.title: Step 3: Verify Self-Checking Behavior
steps.instructions: Run the lab and confirm each random ALU transaction produces a PASS comparison; then intentionally corrupt the reference model to see `uvm_error` mismatches.
